podcast.title: Use of Devil's Triad
podcast.body: Bartók, a notable classical composer, is cited among the many classical artists who incorporated the "devil's tri tone" (flattened fifth) into their musical works. This demonstrates the broad historical application of this interval in classical music, long before it acquired negative connotations in popular culture. "But then it did show up in a lot of classical compositions from people like Beethoven, Wagner, Debussy, Lyst, Sabelius, Bartok, dozens of others."
